description: Continue FF-output unions after a second fully qualifying capped band
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,520 parameters at 99.120000%, a +0.120000-point margin. There have been 70 prior macro-attempts and 621 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0172/micro-0020 at 1,520/99.12%; the most recent failed result remains attempt-0171/micro-0013, where FF-output pair 236/180 scored 98.98%, because attempt 172 had no failures. Six measured sensitive pairs remain excluded. Hypothesis: the second fully qualifying 20-trial band and increased accuracy margin indicate additional nearest FF-output groups can be merged; an administrative cap is not a scientific boundary. The helper adds one ordered scalar union per official micro-trial with runner-only retention/rollback. Stop at first scored discard/error, no pair, 20 trials, or 25 minutes. This is more informative than switching tensors because the immediately preceding policy again had 100% yield.
summary: The second-cap FF-output continuation evaluated three ordered unions. Two qualified and reduced the frontier from 1,520 to 1,518 parameters; micro-0003 proposed 1,517, failed qualification, and was rolled back. Outcomes: 2 accepts, 1 scored nonqualification, 0 errors. Compute used three official migrations/verifications over about 3m10s. Stop reason: first scored discard before the 20-trial/25-minute cap.
